headline.purpose: What the phone is showing, on the side menu's Now card.

motion.name: trial-drain
motion.purpose: Time left in a trial; stays on with animations off because it is information.

motion.name: rec-blink
motion.purpose: Recording lamp and chip; stops when Windows animation effects are off.

breakpoints.name: side-menu
breakpoints.value: 380px wide, scrolls beyond the screen height

components.name: Recommended answer
components.description: The first answer in an assistant step; Enter picks it. Consequence on the second line.

components.name: Quick action key
components.description: 2x2 keys in the side menu. On/off keys carry a lamp: filled when on, hollow when off.

components.name: Ruled row
components.description: A line in a side menu group; the reconnect glyph marks actions that interrupt the picture.

components.name: Lens track
components.description: The comparison 1 · 2 · 1; the current phase filled with ink, time left as a draining line.

components.name: State chip
components.description: Non-interactive state on the Now card: recording time, reconnection locked, saved / this session only.

components.name: Field
components.description: Text input and closed select share one field: 3:1 boundary, 2px focus border.

narrative.overview: Mirrodex puts a phone on the PC screen and tunes it by asking 'one or two?'. The interface is a ruled record of what is showing now, and every change is compared one at a time: current, changed, current. Nothing that interrupts the live picture happens without saying so first, and nothing is saved without an explicit 'better'.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled label/value rows instead of stacked equal buttons
Amber lamp from the logo's eyes for anything switched on
One reconnect glyph on every action that interrupts the picture
Dashed 'pencil' for values chosen but not applied

rules.name: One ink per view
rules.body: Only the expected next step is filled. With no pending change the side menu has none.

rules.name: Shape carries state
rules.body: Filled/hollow lamps, lock glyphs, dashes and tone glyphs so state survives high contrast.

rules.name: Two columns
rules.body: Icons start at the 12px inset, text at 38px, across cards, keys, rows and messages.

dos: Do mark every reconnecting action with the reconnect glyph and swap it for a lock while locked.
Do keep the trial window and side menu beside the mirror window, never over it.
donts: Don't nest cards or add shadows, glass or gradients.
Don't give leaving-the-flow options the same weight as answers.
Don't make a destructive action the Enter default.
